assessment: The revised contract is technically coherent and sufficiently bounded for explicit human architecture/data-handling direction. It proposes unverified scene-owned citation metadata and qualified headless operations, with complete lifecycle preservation and explicit containment of cited new-project creation/copy and native export. It does not claim metadata proves a prior attachment, source support or authority. All material review ambiguities are resolved; no technical planning blocker remains. Representation, retention and containment are still proposals, not approved implementation.
scopeAssessment: This is a robust immediate lifecycle dependency after J3, while source-aware project copy, safe live-editor adoption and native citation presentation remain separate roadmap contracts. Gating cited copy/export avoids silently dropping or rebinding metadata and avoids new private-source disclosure. Existing uncited workflows remain in scope for compatibility; the unreproduced existing Save-as-new await risk is recorded separately rather than claimed fixed.

resolvedFindings.issue: Unscoped duplicate-tuple refusal conflicted with preserving an orphan's old target tuple during slide duplication.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Tuple uniqueness is per containing scene; citation IDs remain project-wide unique. An orphan tuple may be preserved in another scene and remains scope-mismatched rather than retargeted or discarded.

resolvedFindings.issue: Current duplicateScene recursively remints element IDs but exposes no old-to-new map; the scene schema also permits absent kind-specific payloads.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The final contract explicitly requires a cardinality-aware mapping alongside recursive ID reminting, deterministic fixed-format citation-ID allocation with deck-wide reservations, and explicit [kind,null] projections for absent kind payloads.

resolvedFindings.issue: Denying only named citation commands would leave an actor:agent raw slide.insert metadata-supply path after schema extension.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The final pin denies newly supplied/altered citation metadata in agent generic payload ingress, while ordinary edits preserve records, deterministic duplication uses engine-owned remapping and private canonical undo/redo restores exact snapshots. Existing H/tool authority stays closed.

technicalBasis.topic: Authoritative representation and every write boundary
technicalBasis.assessment: Optional bounded scene-owned records preserve one authoritative document. Shape/project validation covers engine initialization, inserted scenes and generic create/save/runtime-save/history restore in both adapters; source.projectId must equal the canonical document. Element-local fields remain invalid. Generic new-project creation rejects nonempty records before writes. No command-only admission assumption or source side document is introduced.

technicalBasis.topic: Unverified metadata, undo and private authority
technicalBasis.assessment: Generic same-project metadata may remain unresolved/stale/forged and never proves source existence, qualified attachment or support. This deliberately supports engine undo200 beyond durable recoverable payload20 pruning without a receipt ledger or restored source body. New qualification operations re-enter current exact-owner/project/catalog authority with no admin override; accepted admin project CRUD never acquires private-source resolution. Removal remains possible for missing/hidden/locked targets without source lookup.

Attach/replace/remove/inspect use fully captured strict requests and one canonical owner lock. Fresh attach requires exact current target, retained current-generation source and any transient exact scalar quote. Validated engine batches and canonical save/history share one commit; no-op replacement changes no counters, and history failure rolls back. Protected target/ancestor rules, complete output bounds, static errors and private refusal rollback are pinned without widening H or provider authority.

technicalBasis.topic: Portable content anchors and honest observations
technicalBasis.assessment: A browser-safe versioned ordered content projection and WebCrypto digest avoid node:crypto imports into model/browser code. Exact JSON escaping preserves lone surrogates before UTF-8 encoding; payload absence/defaults, finite-number serialization and aggregate node/depth/byte budgets are explicit. Geometry/style/citation metadata does not get hashed as authored wording. Equality is merely current content versus stored hash, including for forged hashes; no trust flag or factual support follows. Saved ranges have no quote and can only be range-valid, never quote-matched.

technicalBasis.topic: Edit, duplication, recompile and restoration lifecycle
technicalBasis.assessment: Ordinary edits retain old records/anchors; element deletion leaves removable orphans, and slide deletion/undo/history preserve exact scene ownership semantics. Duplicate mappings are cardinality-aware; ambiguous/orphan/scope-mismatched targets never acquire accidental new matches. Recompile carries the scene array verbatim rather than following semanticRef fallback; detached scenes remain authoritative. Source clear never rewrites/restores scenes or sources and old generations cannot revive after identical re-registration.

technicalBasis.topic: Copy/export containment and deferred surface direction
technicalBasis.assessment: Cited generic create/copy/import refuses atomically instead of dropping or inventing source IDs. Current SceneViewer copies unsaved scenes and only changes projectRef after await; source-aware rebinding and the unreproduced adoption race remain explicit future work. Renderer-level preflight refuses any nonempty citation array before visibility filtering/native byte generation for all callers, including hidden/orphan/stale metadata and admin stored export. No speaker notes or private URLs/snippets are disclosed. Uncited export keeps accepted behavior.

focusedValidationAssessment: After separate implementation direction, the plan calls for new pure schema/command/hash/lifecycle cases, shared actual SQLite/PostgreSQL ownership/atomic-history/clear/restore contracts, one bounded interleaving per backend, narrow affected tool/command/schema checks, central export refusal, typecheck and governance. It does not repeat old provider/browser/native/benchmark matrices or infer rendering quality from a refusal. Missing PostgreSQL remains unexecuted. Inventory must be pinned before execution; scope/evidence must be amended if new browser-visible behavior is needed.

humanDirection.requiredDecision: Approve or revise the concrete scene-owned unverified metadata/history policy, fresh owner qualification and explicit cited-deck creation/copy/native-export containment before code.
humanDirection.notImplied: Technical readiness approves no chosen representation, new retention/data handling, implementation, source-aware copying, notes/visible citation surface or later roadmap work. Accepted J3 remains the runtime baseline.

writes: Only this independent planning review record. No runtime, source, tests, plan, roadmap, state or Git mutation.
stopPoint: Commit the unchanged readiness record and request explicit human direction on this concrete J4 proposal. Stop before implementation; readiness is not acceptance or authorization of later copy/export/creation contracts.
